title: VS Code Integration

body.text: extensions for VS Code and JetBrains
— see diffs right in the editor, share your highlighted selection as context, and invoke it with a keyboard shortcut.

example: "Highlight a function in the editor and ask 'does this function have any bugs?' — Claude sees the selected code immediately"

title: Terminal or IDE — how to choose

body.text: You don't have to choose one:
the IDE suits work with lots of diffs · the terminal suits automation and SSH to a server
— both modes are the same Claude Code, with equal capabilities.

example: "Building a feature at your desk → use it in VS Code / running a config-fix script on a server over SSH → use the CLI"
